question: Prediction of MCI-to-AD conversion among ADNI MCI participants. The shared channel is structural MRI: P-93 is imaging-only (baseline T1 MRI plus FDG-PET synthesised from the MRI), and P-168 combines neuropsychological tests, FreeSurfer MRI volumes and demographics. Allowed differences: horizon (36 months from baseline vs 2 years from a month-24 index exam), single baseline vs five-visit input, predictor set and validation.
metric: AUC with AUC (0.838 vs 0.93). The ledger's claim_a still names P-188, a stub duplicate of P-93; the figure 0.838 is P-93's.

figures.P-93: MCI-conversion AUC 0.838 (ACC 0.780) on an independent ADNI test set of MRI-only subjects. The text gives 177 (81 sMCI, 96 pMCI); Tables 2 and 5 give 159 (66/93). Hanley-McNeil with n1=96, n2=81: SE 0.0298, 95% CI 0.780-0.896; with 93/66: SE 0.0310, 95% CI 0.777-0.899.
figures.P-168: LSTM, five visits, NP+MRI+demographics: AUC 0.93 +/- 0.06 (fold SD), n=347 (77/270). Hanley-McNeil: SE 0.0206, 95% CI 0.890-0.970. MRI-only: LSTM 0.86 (SE 0.0279, 95% CI 0.805-0.915); random forest 0.85 (SE 0.0287, 95% CI 0.794-0.906).
figures.comparison: Headline figures are separated: 0.93 lies above P-93's 0.896/0.899 upper bound, and 0.838 lies below P-168's 0.890 lower bound.

matched_figure_check: P-168 reports the result in P-93's channel (MRI measures only). The random-forest MRI model scores 0.85 (CI 0.794-0.906) and the MRI LSTM 0.86 (CI 0.805-0.915). Both intervals contain P-93's 0.838, and P-93's interval (0.780-0.896) contains both 0.85 and 0.86, so the matched figures agree in both directions. The headline gap comes from P-168 adding cognitive tests and longitudinal inputs, and the papers' own data dissolve it. Condition 3 fails.
reason: The headline AUCs (0.838 imaging-only vs 0.93 cognition plus MRI over five visits) are separated beyond uncertainty. But P-168 reports MRI-only models (0.85 and 0.86) whose intervals and P-93's interval each contain the other's estimate. Restricted to the shared channel, the two papers agree, so the pair fails condition 3 and does not qualify.
